akh.text: Oketra is the god of solidarity who patrols Naktamun, shooting dangers seen through the Hekma and leading initiates through the first Trial, and she tells them to stand with their crop and become the storm.
She recognizes Gideon as Kytheon Iora, one of hers, and he pledges himself to her to face the trials.
When the dragon attacks, her arrows fail to harm him, and he blanks the minds of Oketra and Hazoret, who fall defeated.
During the Hour of Promise, she tells Hapatra that the gods are there to protect the mortals, and with Kefnet she fights the scorpion god, ending its pursuit with an arrow of white light.
Oketra then leaps between Tuya and the scorpion god and is impaled by its stinger, and her death enrages Kawit, who takes up one of her arrows.

jmp.text: As God-Eternal Oketra, she appears over Ravnica, where her shot pierces Gideon's pegasus and he tumbles through the air with the Blackblade in hand.
